_comment: Budgets track current actuals with ~10% headroom; see vanilla-breeze-3cv4. vanilla-breeze.css ratcheted down 2026-07-06 (155k→105k) after decorative themes moved out of the main bundle (vanilla-breeze-16or) — do not raise it back to admit bundled themes.
_comment_core_js: vanilla-breeze-core.js raised 2026-07-24 (100k→112k) by vanilla-breeze-zccp: the core entry carried 2 of the framework's ~44 lazy-load guards, so gestures, focus-trap, loading buttons, floating labels, hotkeys, the email/newsletter forms and the paged/sortable/toggle upscales were dead on every production docs page. Guards now come from src/lib/lazy-guards.js and cost ~10k gzip here. esbuild builds this entry without code splitting, so a guarded module is inlined and merely deferred in evaluation — real chunking would win most of that back.
_comment_core_js_2026_11: raised 2026-11-03 (112k→120k) for the F-element review: form-coordinator (submitter-preserving submits, summary rebuilt from text nodes, conditional disabling, i18n), form-field (FACE validity bridging, describedby wiring, setError lifecycle) and its OTP/password enhancements grew ~4k gzip. Guarding them saves nothing without code splitting — tracked in vanilla-breeze-v6qb.
_comment_s_2026_11: raised 2026-11-05 for the S review: core.js 128k→134k (128.1k local: site-search dialog/combobox, settings-panel rewrite, selection-menu keyboard path, status-message dismiss, sanitizer custom-element policy), extras.js 100k→106k (101.6k: social-embed iframe providers, short-cuts, slide-accept/stepper/split-surface), vanilla-breeze.css 108k→113k (108.9k: forced-colors, sub/sup, section/svg, select/search/summary). CI gzip runs ~0.2k above local.
_comment_themes_2026_11: themes/* raised 2026-11-04 (4000→4400): win9x reached 3997 local after the M+N menu scoping (CI ~0.2k higher).
_comment_utils_2026_11: raised 2026-11-07 for the utility-attribute review: core.js 142k→147k (shared announcer, number-format and char-shortcuts helpers, hotkey aliases/scope, select-all/copy/spoiler rewrites, inert definitions for 29 CSS-only elements; 141.4k local) and the full bundle 330k→336k (322.4k local).
_comment_attrs_2026_11: raised 2026-11-07 for the attribute reviews (forms, effects, styling+shapes): core.js 134k→142k and extras 106k→111k because trigger handlers, transition presets, stamp and flipboard now ship wherever the effects runtime ships (they were silently missing), plus the form-conditions/persist-filter/reset helpers; core.css 85k→88k and vanilla-breeze.css 113k→116k for shape RTL/forced-colors/print rules, the 16 section-edge pairs, layout-badge shapes and callout/bubble layers; full bundle 318k→330k (316.8k local). CI gzip runs ~0.2k above local. Code splitting (vanilla-breeze-v6qb) remains the real fix.
